extracted.name: Creamy Cheesecake
extracted.description: This cheesecake is creamier than most cheesecakes, and very easy to make. Use grated lemon zest or 1 teaspoon lemon extract for flavoring.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Beat softened cream cheese slightly. Add eggs, sugar, vanilla, and lemon zest. Beat until light and fluffy. Pour mixture into crust.
Bake in the preheated oven until firm, about 25 minutes. Let cheesecake cool then top with cherry or blueberry pie filling, if desired.
